example: Il m'a posé un lapin hier soir.
exampleTranslation: He stood me up last night.
quip: Someone did this to me in 1994. I remember.

meaning: to wander with no destination, just enjoying the walk
example: J'adore flâner dans Paris.
exampleTranslation: I love wandering around Paris.
quip: My only form of cardio.

example: J'ai hâte !
exampleTranslation: I can't wait! (say this instead)
quip: Say “j'ai hâte”. Trust me.

example: Trop tard, les carottes sont cuites.
exampleTranslation: Too late, it's game over.
quip: Dramatic. I respect it.

example: J'achète des pommes de terre.
exampleTranslation: I'm buying potatoes.
quip: The fanciest name a potato has ever had.

example: J'ai le cafard ce soir.
exampleTranslation: I'm feeling a bit low tonight.
quip: Every Sunday at 6pm.

meaning: thinking of the perfect comeback when it's too late
example: J'ai encore eu l'esprit de l'escalier.
exampleTranslation: I thought of the perfect reply too late again.
quip: I'm still working on one from 1994.

example: Il s'est blessé au genou.
exampleTranslation: He hurt his knee.
quip: Do not say it after someone sneezes.

phrase: avoir un chat dans la gorge
literal: to have a cat in your throat
meaning: to have a frog in your throat
example: Pardon, j'ai un chat dans la gorge.
exampleTranslation: Sorry, I've got a frog in my throat.
quip: English chose a frog. France chose a cat.

example: Ce film me donne la chair de poule.
exampleTranslation: This film gives me goosebumps.
quip: Walruses don't get these. Too much blubber.

meaning: the feeling of really not being bothered
example: J'ai la flemme de cuisiner.
exampleTranslation: I can't be bothered to cook.
quip: My natural state.

example: Une chauve-souris vole dans le jardin.
exampleTranslation: A bat is flying in the garden.
quip: Rude. Bats have perfectly nice fur.

example: J'ai une peur bleue des araignées.
exampleTranslation: I'm terrified of spiders.
quip: Blue is apparently the scariest colour.

phrase: coûter les yeux de la tête
literal: to cost the eyes of your head
meaning: to cost an arm and a leg
example: Ce manteau coûte les yeux de la tête.
exampleTranslation: This coat costs an arm and a leg.
quip: I'll keep my eyes, thank you.

example: Il y a une jolie librairie près d'ici.
exampleTranslation: There's a lovely bookshop near here.
quip: The library is “la bibliothèque”.

example: Elle est tombée dans les pommes.
exampleTranslation: She fainted.
quip: Honestly, the best place to faint.

meaning: the joy of seeing someone again after a long time
example: Quelles belles retrouvailles !
exampleTranslation: What a lovely reunion!
quip: Me and my favourite fish.

example: Prends ton parapluie, il pleut des cordes.
exampleTranslation: Take your umbrella, it's pouring.
quip: Excellent weather, if you're me.

meaning: to tell lies, spin tall tales
example: Arrête de me raconter des salades !
exampleTranslation: Stop telling me stories!
quip: I only tell fish stories. All true.

example: Le café est au coin de la rue.
exampleTranslation: The café is on the street corner.
quip: A coin is “une pièce”. Keep up.

example: Le porc-épic a beaucoup de piquants.
exampleTranslation: The porcupine has lots of quills.
quip: Fair, to be honest.

meaning: to grumble and moan, practically as a hobby
example: Il râle tout le temps.
exampleTranslation: He moans all the time.
quip: Finally, my national sport.

literal: to add your grain of salt
meaning: to butt in with your opinion
example: Il faut toujours qu'il mette son grain de sel.
exampleTranslation: He always has to stick his oar in.
quip: I add mine to every conversation. Politely.

literal: it's the end of the beans
meaning: it's the last straw, all is lost
example: Plus de café ? C'est la fin des haricots !
exampleTranslation: No more coffee? That's the end of everything!
quip: Beans: the foundation of civilisation.

example: J'ai envie d'une glace.
exampleTranslation: I fancy an ice cream.
quip: Always. Fish flavour, ideally.

meaning: the feeling of being out of your element somewhere foreign
example: Quel dépaysement !
exampleTranslation: What a change of scene!
quip: Every time I leave my iceberg.

example: Dimanche, je fais la grasse matinée.
exampleTranslation: On Sunday I'm having a lie-in.
quip: Every morning is a fat morning if you believe.

example: Elle achète un nouveau soutien-gorge.
exampleTranslation: She's buying a new bra.
quip: No comment.

example: Tu es encore dans la lune !
exampleTranslation: You're miles away again!
quip: Too far. I prefer the ice.

meaning: to curl up and read for pleasure
example: J'aime bouquiner le dimanche.
exampleTranslation: I love curling up with a book on Sundays.
quip: With reading glasses, obviously.

example: Ça a été le coup de foudre.
exampleTranslation: It was love at first sight.
quip: Happened to me with a herring once.

example: Sans conservateurs !
exampleTranslation: No preservatives! (the word you actually want)
quip: Preservatives are “conservateurs”. Learn this one early.
